output.attribution_rationale: Within the mastery condition, randomized students received the same CAL platform and progression rules, differing only in access to the AI tutor.

conflict.note: The entry discloses research funding and platform development, but the source establishes no vendor funding, commercial ownership, equity, patent, or licence.

tests.note: The trial was randomized and registered, but the text does not establish a preregistered primary endpoint, so evidence grade A cannot be confirmed.

output.summary: The source supports a randomized classroom comparison showing suggestive delayed learning gains and improved post-mistake recovery with AI. Its prose reports a 3.1-percentage-point delayed gain while its tables report 3.2, and it does not establish a preregistered primary endpoint.
